subject: Help with Hebrew Letters in a web site

messages.author: 643228470bdff463
messages.subject: Help with Hebrew Letters in a web site
parts:
Hi,
I'm reading a URL that has text in Hebrew and English.
I have used several different types of encoding but  the Hebrew text shows me "giberish".

The following is the code in R:
library(XML)

fileUrl2 <- "http://www.old.health.gov.il/units/pharmacy/trufot/PerutTrufa.asp?Reg_Number=119%2001%2029909%2000&safa=e"

doc2<-htmlTreeParse(fileUrl2,useInternalNodes=TRUE,encoding ="UTF-8")

xpathSApply(doc2, "//title", xmlValue)

I get:
[1] "\xeeùøã äáøéàåú - îàâø úøåôåú "

It should be: 
<title>משרד הבריאות - מאגר תרופות </title>

I did used: encoding: iso8859-8, windows-1255, etc. but I had similar result, meaning "giberish".
